## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature (minor bump)
- [ ] fix — bug fix (patch bump)
- [ ] refactor / perf — no behavior change
- [ ] docs
- [ ] chore / build / ci
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE (describe migration below)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows **Conventional Commits** (e.g. `feat(widgets): ...`).
- [ ] Commits are **signed/verified**.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm test:cov` passes (coverage >= 80%).
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change.
- [ ] Updated docs (`README.md` / `docs/`) where relevant.
- [ ] Regenerated `openapi.json` (`pnpm openapi`) if the API surface changed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or long-lived credentials added.
- [ ] GitHub Actions / container digests remain SHA-pinned.
